name: Bombardier ART Mark II (2nd generation, 2-car train)
family: Bombardier Advanced Rapid Transit / Innovia Metro
operators: British Columbia Rapid Transit Company (SkyTrain Expo and Millennium Lines)

width.rationale: Typical ART Mark II body width; not found in a source.

seats.rationale: Derived from the cited source; see notes.

standingArea.rationale: 198 standing places; the source states no density, so 4 pers/m2 is assumed (range 3-6 pers/m2, the spread of densities manufacturers quote).

totalCapacityQuoted.rationale: Derived from the cited source; see notes.

costRecords.note: Bid of $113 million for 34 second-generation Mark II cars (contract won November 2006), as reported by Wikipedia.

livery.rationale: approximation of the blue and grey TransLink livery of the second-generation Mark II (first generation was white)

notes: Linear-induction-motor light metro. Length and capacity per 2-car train from the SkyTrain configuration table (second-generation Mark II, 2009/2010); seated = 2 x 33 seats per car (derived). maxSpeedKmh is the 80 km/h stated for the Expo/Millennium Line ART fleet. Power is 650 V DC via a fourth-rail pair with LIM reaction rail; 650 V is not one of the project supply systems, so supplySystems is empty. Automated (driverless) operation; no GoA grade stated. Figures from Wikipedia (secondary).
